argv: import hashlib,importlib.metadata as m,json,pathlib,re,sys;d=m.distribution('checkwash'); expected=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text());actual={p:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(d.locate_file(p)).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in expected};assert actual==expected; assert d.version==sys.argv[3];deps={re.sub(r'[-_.]+','-',p.metadata['Name']).lower():p.version for p in m.distributions()};assert set(deps)<= {'pip','setuptools','checkwash'};r={'version':d.version,'direct_url':json.loads(d.read_text('direct_url.json')),'dependencies':deps,'members':actual,'requires':d.requires};pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
raw_exits.name: advertised-identity
